notes: Season 5 barely changed multiplayer guns. The big gunplay patch was Update 1.3.3.0 (30 June), so the builds here still apply.
Only nerfs: SVDM and M39 EMR recoil (spamming is punished). Controller recoil assist was cut from 11% to 5%.
REDSEC armor nerfs (SCW-10, SG 553R, KV9, KTS100…) do not apply to multiplayer.
The MK 24's Underslung Mount underbarrel has been disabled since launch week.
